is_prerequisite.title: Is Prerequisite
is_prerequisite.description: True only for a supporting lemma registered for the current exploration task: no separate insight base points; it does not complete the task

claims_problem_solved.title: Claims Problem Solved
claims_problem_solved.description: Completion claim only: 0 for all intermediate insights; 1 for a complete proof of the original problem P; -1 for a complete proof of its negation. Independent of assigned research direction; not verification.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.description: Ordinary Lean definitions/imports needed to state the fixed proposition; no proof placeholders or new axioms

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: A complete Lean proposition, including all intended quantifiers and hypotheses; not a theorem declaration or proof

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Previously verified artifact IDs needed by the proposition; frozen when registered
